analysisId.description: The analysis round that generated this hypothesis.

agenteAlvo.description: Which agent the hypothesis is about.

observacao.example: The agent reopened the same task three times.

hipotese.example: The instructions don't say when to consider the task done.

sugestao.example: Add an explicit definition-of-done criterion to the instruction.

confiancaPercent.description: Confidence declared by the model itself. Not a measurement, a self-report.

evidenceEventIds.description: Log events that support the hypothesis. This is what makes the evidence auditable instead of taken on faith.

terminationAnalysis.description: Present only on hypotheses about an abnormally terminated session.

causa.description: The ORIGIN of the failure, never deduced by elimination (lesson from ADR 0020).

analise.example: The agent stopped responding after a 90s tool call.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project, session, or hypothesis does not exist.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
